reviewType: actual exact source review, read-only inspection
observations: Native510.owner_check and Preservation.owner are reused without duplicate ownership logic.
Owner PID and start identity are derived from the fixed gateway service and procfs; no caller owner claims are accepted.
Read dispatch precedes Controller construction and its potentially mutating shared exception path.
One monotonic deadline bounds native checks and systemctl timeout; route/auth checks are absent and must not be claimed.
The helper requires root inside the HQ gateway cgroup; no supported privilege/cancellation bridge has been established.
ABH target source hashes match native-targets.json; the patch remains evidence in the owning OpenClaw fork and is not applied to ABH executable tools.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Updated tests use actual subprocess.run with tracked real harmless sleeping Python child; cancellation and timeout assert returncode plus absent PID. SIGTERM timer starts only after child creation under installed owner-read handlers and is cancelled/joined. Remote execution still required.
Updated test mutates start identity on third proc stat read, during second unchanged owner_check. Missing/malformed proc and nonzero service cases added.
